reason: Purpose clause for land titles registration and guaranteed land title.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Purpose of land titles registration

evidenceText: system for the registration of the title to land
statutory authority for guaranteed land title

proposedGroups.reason: The text states the Act purpose: title registration and guaranteed land title authority.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State the purpose of the land titles system and guaranteed land title authority.

reason: The section separates land brought under the Act from Registry Act recording restrictions and exceptions.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Parcels subject to or excepted from the Act
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections set application to parcels, exception or inclusion by the Lieutenant-Governor in Council, and Crown binding.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain what land the Act applies to and how parcels may be excepted or added.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Registry Act recording limits and exceptions
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections restrict Registry Act recording for land titles land and set application-pending and Registrar General certificate exceptions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify when an instrument for land titles land may still be recorded under the Registry Act.

reason: Focused boundary rule between Land Titles Act coverage and Personal Property Security Act interests.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Personal Property Security Act interests and land title scope
proposedGroups.reason: The subsections exclude PPSA security-interest agreements except as provided and preserve listed land-interest applications.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Distinguish PPSA security interests from land interests covered by the Land Titles Act.

reason: Section 3 is a dense definition section; validated focus is grouped around parcel identification, court or district terms, and instrument or electronic-format terms actually accepted as defined terms in the operative source.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approved parcel identifier definition
proposedGroups.reason: The target expressly defines approved parcel identifier for parcels of land.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify what approved parcel identifier means under the Land Titles Act.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Court and district definitions
proposedGroups.reason: The target expressly defines court and district for land titles administration and applications.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State how court and district are defined for the Act.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Instrument and electronic format definitions
proposedGroups.reason: These terms define key instrument, enactment, grant, disposition, and electronic-format concepts used in registration workflows.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain the defined instrument and electronic-format concepts used by the land titles system.

reason: Single establishment rule assigning administration of the land titles system to Service New Brunswick.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Establishment of the land titles registration system

evidenceText: established in and for the Province a system of land titles registration

proposedGroups.reason: The text creates the system and names its administrator.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State who administers the land titles registration system.

reason: Administrative section on appointment, powers, remuneration, fee handling, and pension coverage for officers.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Registrar General, registrar, and deputy appointments
proposedGroups.reason: All subsections concern the appointment and status of the Registrar General, registrars, and deputies.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Describe appointment, duties, remuneration, fee, and pension rules for land titles officers.

reason: Single Service New Brunswick designation power for Registrar General duties or powers.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Service New Brunswick designation of Registrar General functions

evidenceText: may designate any person to perform any of the duties or exercise any of the powers of the Registrar General

proposedGroups.reason: The text authorizes designation and specification of duties or powers.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State how Service New Brunswick may designate a person to exercise Registrar General functions.

reason: Single seal-of-office requirement for the Registrar General and registrars.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Seals of office for land titles officers

evidenceText: The Registrar General and each registrar shall have a seal of office

proposedGroups.reason: The section requires approved seals of office.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify which land titles officers must have an approved seal of office.

reason: Good-faith immunity rule for specified officers and persons acting under their authority.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Good-faith immunity of land titles officers

evidenceText: No action lies against the Registrar General
if he acted in good faith in pursuing his duties

proposedGroups.reason: The text protects specified officers and authorized persons for good-faith acts or omissions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify who receives good-faith immunity and the condition for it.

reason: The section separates access and evidentiary use of records from the definition of records.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Inspection, copies, and evidentiary status of records
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections govern record inspection, sealed copies, an application-document exception, and certified evidence.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain access to land titles records and when copies or reproductions are evidence.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Definition of records for land titles evidence
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 9(3) defines records across written, printed, photographic, magnetic, mechanical, electronic, and computer forms.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recognize what counts as records under section 9.

reason: Presumption for documents purporting to be issued by land titles officers without proof of signature or official character.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Presumption for documents issued by land titles officers

evidenceText: shall be presumed to be a document signed, made or issued by the Registrar General
without proof of the signature or the official character

proposedGroups.reason: The text sets an authentication presumption for listed officer documents.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State the evidentiary presumption for documents purporting to be issued by land titles officers.

reason: The section divides into assigning identifiers, associating descriptions, and changes after parcel alteration.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Assigning parcel identifiers
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 10.1(1) gives the registrar authority to assign parcel identifiers.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State the registrar power to assign parcel identifiers.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Associating land descriptions with parcel identifiers
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections cover application-based, registrar-initiated, and Registrar General-directed association of descriptions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain when a parcel description may be associated with a parcel identifier.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Parcel identifier changes after subdivision or consolidation
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 10.1(5) covers amended descriptions, retired identifiers, and newly created parcels.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Describe how parcel identifiers and descriptions may change when a parcel is altered.

reason: Single registrar duty to maintain parcel identifier and associated description records.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Record of parcel identifiers and descriptions

evidenceText: maintain a record of parcel identifiers assigned to parcels of land
descriptions associated with those parcel identifiers

proposedGroups.reason: The text requires the registrar to maintain the identifier-description record.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State what record the registrar must maintain for parcel identifiers.

reason: Focused rule on the legal effect of describing land by approved parcel identifier.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Legal effect of references to approved parcel identifiers
proposedGroups.reason: The subsections say an approved parcel identifier is sufficient and fixes or presumes the land affected.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain how an approved parcel identifier identifies land in instruments and dealings.

reason: Focused rule for parcel identifiers assigned to consolidated adjoining registered parcels.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Parcel identifiers for consolidated registered land
proposedGroups.reason: The subsections connect consolidation applications with parcel identifier assignment and one-parcel status.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State when a consolidated parcel receives a parcel identifier and its subdivision effect.

reason: The section separates application entitlement and contents from electronic submission, retention, and production duties.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Application requirements to register unregistered land
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections identify who may apply and the required form, parcel identifier, fee, certificate of title, affidavit, and supporting information.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify who may apply to register unregistered land and what must accompany the application.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Electronic application duties and affidavit handling
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections govern electronic applications, certificate format, affidavit possession, fee payment, retention, and production.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain subscriber duties for electronic applications to register land.

reason: The section has distinct stages for application handling, existing interests, and the Registrar General registration order.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Forwarding, rejecting, or withdrawing applications
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections address complete applications, incomplete rejections with notice, and withdrawal before certificate issuance.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Explain how an application is forwarded, rejected, or withdrawn.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Existing interests when title is registered by order
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections direct handling of instruments evidencing interests and preserve their force after registration.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Describe how existing interests are handled when title is registered subject to them.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Registrar General order to register title
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections authorize an order based on the certificate of title and require delivery to the registrar.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: State when the Registrar General may order registration of title.
